scenes.narration: Open the File menu and choose Plot. Tick all copper layers, mirror the bottom layer, include the board edge, and press Plot.

scenes.title: From idea to board
scenes.narration: Every PCB follows the same path: draw the schematic, give each part a footprint, place and route the board, and export the files.

scenes.label: A finished PCB
scenes.narration: Here is what a finished printed circuit board looks like, with copper tracks joining every pad.
